answer: Harberger-taxed grove slots block fake identities. Each identity takes one willow plot in the grove ledger, posts its opal value, 300, and pays 30 tax an epoch, 10% of that value; anyone may buy it at that price. Underprice, lose it; overprice, bleed tax; skip tax, lose the plot. Rented valuations fail the buyout. 1,000 fakes pay 30,000 tax an epoch against a 40,000 pool and lock 70,000 in bonds. An honest identity pays 30 once, keeps its plot.
